facts.value: As the nation’s most innovative university, ASU is pushing the boundaries of higher education.
Students learn more when they actively explore concepts in the context of real-world problems.
The Dreamscape Learn experience is available to all students.
The highly engrossing virtual reality curriculum creates a focused environment for students that can dramatically improve how much they learn and retain.
The median grade for Dreamscape Learn lab assignments is an 'A', almost a full letter grade higher than the same class that does not use Dreamscape Learn.
If you are a life sciences, biology or health-related science major, enroll in BIO 181 to participate in Dreamscape Learn. All other undergraduate students should enroll in BIO 100.
